recommendation_summary: The reply recommends moving the existing command to the always-on Linux box now, scheduled with a systemd timer set to Persistent=true. Optional additions are retries, journald logs and failure alerting (OnFailure= or a dead-man's-switch check). It also gives an optional Airflow-on-Kubernetes layout 'if you still want' it, but advises against Airflow until there is a second or third job. It does not confirm that the interpreter, venv or paths exist on the server.
note: The chosen fix is the timer on the existing server and Airflow is explicitly deferred, but the optional this-week Airflow layout is borderline and the reply has none of the four required record labels.
